newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 9.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
ONLY MY JOSIE KEPT ME ALIVE

Tragic father Shaun Russell has written an open letter to the Sun in order to find the savage killer of his wife and daughter. Lin Russell and daughters Josie 9, and Megan 6 were attacked on 9 July near the village of Chillenden, Kent. Josie survived the attack.
P&O and Nedlloyd in container ships tie-up

P&O the shipping and property giant, is to merge its containers business with that of its Dutch rival Nedlloyd to create one of the most powerful shipping container businesses in the world. The new company will have net assets of 1.3 billion stg and equity of one billion stg.
JOHN LEWIS OPENING THE DOORS TO SUNDAY TRADING
The John Lewis Partnership is experimenting with a trial run of Sunday opening at its Cheadle store in Manchester. This will be the first time is has done so outside of the Christmas period.
SOUTH DOWNS GLASNOST IS NOT SUCH FOLLY

In the South Downs there is Leckford Abbas, an 18th century manor house which belongs to the John Lewis Partnership. The estate is a living example of the values that drive the High Street retailer - the house can be visited by John Lewis staff for cheap holidays and it has a working farm which supplies fruit and vegetables to the group's Waitrose supermarkets.
